messages:
Avery: Hey folks! Thought it would be fun to do a tiny non-Santa holiday thing — 'Mini-Plant Adoption + Holiday Lights Bingo'. :seedling::sparkles: Quick rules in one line: bring a small potted plant or a tiny ornament, put it on the pickup table in the kitchen by Friday 3pm, grab a new one you like. Optional: decorate it and snap a photo for the bingo card. Sign up below if you want to participate!

Sam: Love this. Count me in. I have a stubborn little pothos that needs a new home. :vines:

Priya: Ooh yes. Can I bring a fake succulent? My apartment is a plant murderer. :sweat_smile: Also — where's the bingo card?

Avery: @Priya fake succulents absolutely welcome. Bingo card is here: https://intranet.redwood/holiday-bingo (just a simple Google Sheet, add your name). Box on the kitchen counter will be labeled "Mini-Plant Swap".

Javier: I can bring tiny LED fairy lights to share for decorating — marked as "sparkle kit". Also happy to volunteer to label things if people want.

Lina: @Avery what counts as a tiny ornament vs plant? Trying to avoid the Great Desk-Cactus Debacle of last year. :grimacing:

Avery: Good call. If it's under ~6 inches tall and fits in a small carry bag, it's in. No soil-free glass globes that roll. :grin:

Marcus: Sign me up. I will probably attach a tiny hand-written care note to the plant I bring. Low-maintenance (hopefully).

Zoe: Can someone take a picture of the pickup table after setup so remote folks can feel the FOMO? :camera_flash: I’ll throw a virtual reaction if it looks cute.

holiday-bot: Reminder: "Mini-Plant Swap" drop-off window closes Fri 3:00 PM PST. Add your name to the sheet to be eligible for Bingo prizes.

Sam: @Zoe will do — I’ll snap a photo when I drop mine off on Thursday. Also, small request: can we put a tiny QR code by the box linking to the bingo sheet so people can add names on the go?

Avery: Good idea — I’ll print one. Also small prize for first bingo (mug + hot cocoa packets). Second place gets an extra packet of plant food. Nothing corporate, mostly vibes. :hot_cocoa: :trophy:

Priya: Do we have any remote folks who want to ship a tiny plant/ornament? I can coordinate drop-offs to the kitchen table if someone wants to mail to the office.

Javier: I can accept one package and label it for pickup. Message me the tracking and I’ll sort it.

Lina: Heads up — if shipping small plants, please include a cardboard base to avoid soil mess. And wrap in newspaper. Learned that the hard way.

Marcus: Dropping mine off Friday morning. Can someone volunteer to moderate the table at 3:00 so the swap doesn't turn into a free-for-all?

Avery: @Marcus @Javier volunteered to label and keep things tidy. If anyone else is around at 3pm please stick around for 10 minutes to help.

Zoe: Photo uploaded: https://img.redwood/teams/plant-swap-2025.jpg — looks adorable already. Also doing a virtual reaction chain. :heart_eyes:

Sam: Nice! Also putting a tiny care slip with mine. If it survives two weeks under office fluorescents, it's officially Hardy™.

Priya: Adding my name. Thanks for organizing @Avery — super excited for the tiny-plant-olympics.

Avery: Thanks everyone! If you want to add a silly bonus square to the bingo (e.g., "someone decorates with a tiny hat"), drop it on the sheet. See you at the table and happy holidays! :holmey:
